name: refactoring
description: Use this skill when refactoring existing code or triaging technical debt. Covers behaviour-preserving refactoring technique (one change at a time, tests pass at every step), and a lightweight debt categorisation and prioritisation approach. Distinct from debugging (fixing a bug) and from new feature work.
when: When refactoring existing code or triaging technical debt
do-not-use-when: Fixing a bug — use the debugging skill
Adding new behaviour — that is feature work, not refactoring
The user hasn't asked for a refactor (don't improve adjacent code unprompted)
